Subject: FY27 review cadence & confidential role-transition plan

Team —

As discussed briefly in sync last week, HR asked us to formalize the FY27 review cadence and a confidential plan for two sensitive role transitions on the AI infra team. I put a first-pass timeline and manager kit in the attachments (manager_kit_v1.docx, FY27_timeline.pdf).

Goals for this thread:
- Lock an end-to-end timeline (calibration windows, manager writeups, compensation approvals)
- Agree who does confidential handoffs for the two at-risk roles (we need a short, auditable trail)
- Confirm who will review/approve comp exceptions ahead of exec review

Proposed timeline highlights (see attached PDF for full dates):
- Manager comms draft due: Mar 1
- Calibration week: Apr 11–15
- Compensation approval cutover: Apr 22
- Final letters / change announcements (if any): May 3

Two sensitive items to note (confidential):
1) Potential role transition for Rohan Mehta — may move to a principal IC or be offered a matrixed product role. We should limit circulation of options to the core group (Karthik, Laura, Markus, Monica, Neha, Elena).
2) Short-term backfill for L4 infra lead during interview window — need an interim owner and a clear delegated authority doc.

Action items: Please reply with: 1) any date conflicts, 2) who will be the confidential point of contact for each role, and 3) any legal/comp constraints I should flag to PeopleOps.

Sara from Acme, looping you in since you asked about alignment to our timelines for joint pilots — nothing to action yet, but FYI.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik / team —

I can take the interim owner/backfill decision for the L4 infra lead. My proposed approach:
- Identify a 4-week interim owner by Mar 10 (ideally an internal senior IC who can own outages and daily ops)
- Advertise the temporary delegation to the team as "interim lead" with no public signal of comp/level changes
- Maintain a short confidential log (confidential_changes_matrix.xlsx) that records the delegation, rationale, and review checkpoints (weekly for first month)

Re: calibration facilitation — Apr 12 at 10am works for me. Elena, please send the prep packet; I'll ensure PM and Eng leads have pre-read.

Also flagging a downstream timing risk: the external vendor audit (scheduled Apr 18–20) means we need final manager guidance before Apr 10 to avoid questions during the audit about personnel changes. If we keep the calibration window Apr 11–15, we risk overlap. Suggest we compress manager guidance to Apr 4–8 and move calibration deep-dive to Apr 12 only for execs.

-Markus
